name: The Windwarden's Dilemma
description: A conflict is brewing on the Ironwind Steppe between a druid who guards the ancient stone circle and a Thornwall scholar who wants to extract rare crystal from beneath it. You must choose a side.

steps.description: A conflict is brewing on the Ironwind Steppe. Visit Windwarden Sylara at the stone circle or Geomancer Rhett at the ridge approach, hear what siding with each would mean, and choose a side.
steps.hint: Rhett camps at the Ridge Approach, seven rooms east of Thornwall's Old Citadel Plaza. Sylara keeps the Stone Circle, south twice from there, then east. Type talk rhett.

steps.description: You have sided with Windwarden Sylara. The wolves dragged her carved wolf totem into their kill ground. Search the bones there and bring it back to her.
steps.hint: From the Stone Circle: west three times, south twice, east, then south six times to the Kill Ground. Type get totem from bones.

steps.description: You have Sylara's carved wolf totem. Take it back to her at the stone circle.
steps.hint: From the Kill Ground: north six times, west, north twice, then east three times to the Stone Circle. Type talk sylara.

steps.description: You have sided with Geomancer Rhett. He wants windstone samples chipped from the exposed veins on the Rocky Shelf, just south of his camp.
steps.hint: The Rocky Shelf is one room south of Rhett's camp at the Ridge Approach. Type get sample from veins.

steps.description: You have the windstone samples. Take them back to Rhett at his camp.
steps.hint: Go north from the Rocky Shelf to Rhett's camp at the Ridge Approach. Type talk rhett.

steps.description: You have made your choice and completed the task. The consequences remain to be seen.

rewards.actor: You have chosen your path. The steppe will remember.

flags.description: Which NPC the player sided with
